faqs.question: What kind of live training programs do you offer?
faqs.answer: VaultOfCodes offers a variety of live training programs covering computer science subjects such as programming languages, web development, data science, and more. Expert instructors deliver hands-on sessions to enhance your practical skills. Visit our courses page for more details.

faqs.question: How long are your live training programs?
faqs.answer: The duration of live training programs typically ranges from 6 to 15 hours total over 1 month. Each class is 60-90 mins long, providing comprehensive learning experiences.

faqs.question: Can I get a certificate after completing a program?
faqs.answer: Yes! You will receive 2 certificates: an Internship completion certificate and a Training completion certificate upon successfully completing the programs. You can verify your certificates on our validation page.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of enrolling?
faqs.answer: Benefits include live training, 2 certificates (Internship & Training completion), Free study material (50GB+), Resume building, and Interview preparation.

faqs.question: Are the programs suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Programs cater to participants of all skill levels, including beginners. They provide a solid foundation while offering advanced topics for experienced learners.

faqs.question: Is it mandatory to attend training?
faqs.answer: No, training sessions are conducted for skill development & learning. They are not compulsory to attend.

faqs.question: How can I attend classes and submit assignments?
faqs.answer: You can attend classes, submit assignments, and access study materials through the VaultOfCodes app or web portal. Details are explained in the orientation session after program starts.

faqs.question: What if I face some issue and need help?
faqs.answer: If you face any issue or problem, you can message VaultOfCodes on WhatsApp at 9455345519 or email at vaultofcodes@gmail.com. You can also visit our contact page.

faqs.question: How can I verify my certificate?
faqs.answer: You can verify your certificate online at our validation page. For certificate-related issues, contact VaultOfCodes support team via WhatsApp (9455345519) or email (vaultofcodes@gmail.com).

faqs.question: Where can I find my offer letter?
faqs.answer: Offer letters are available through your student portal. If you cannot find it, please contact VaultOfCodes support via WhatsApp (9455345519).

faqs.question: Who are the trainers at VaultOfCodes?
faqs.answer: Our trainers are industry experts with 10+ years of experience in their respective fields. Learn more about our team on the about us page.

faqs.question: What do students say about VaultOfCodes?
faqs.answer: We have thousands of satisfied students. You can read their success stories and testimonials on our testimonials page.
